about_the_game:
Can you feel the call of Hawaii? These dream islands are ready to welcome you and offer you tons of new challenges. In this Expansion Pack, you will find a new environment inspired by the lush and wild Hawaiian nature, where you can explore 6 new tracks and a new arena. Furthermore, in Monster Jam™ Showdown - Aloha Expansion you will also find the perfect adventure companions in this new tropical experience: 5 trucks ready to let loose in the jungle! The first one is Wreckreation: an RV monster truck always ready for destruction, which, as the quote on its roof goes, invites you to “Go Outside and Play”. Then comes Lumberjack, who debuted in 2015 and will definitely feel at home among the Hawaiian logs. For sure even Fire Rescue and Full Charge, two trucks coming straight out of the toy world, will know how to make their way through the mud and foliage of the islands. Finally, last but not least, a true legend will join the journey, the first version of Grave Digger™'s body ever to showcase a spooky paint job: the Grave Digger™ "Grandma"!

This DLC includes:

  • 1 new environment: 6 tracks and 1 arena

  • Wreckreation with 3 liveries

  • Lumberjack with 3 liveries

  • Fire Rescue with 3 liveries

  • Full Charge with 3 liveries

  • Grave Digger™ "Grandma" with 3 liveries

This DLC is included in Monster Jam™ Showdown - Season Pass.
